name: Sägerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Sägerhof is a traditional 4-star establishment in the heart of Tannheim in the Tannheimer Tal in Tyrol, at around 1,100 metres above sea level. The Lumpert family runs the house as a wellness, tennis and family hotel. Guests can expect a spacious indoor pool, saunas and steam baths, massages, beauty and Ayurveda treatments as well as a fitness offering. In summer and winter, two outdoor tennis courts and an indoor tennis hall are available free of charge. The hotel is largely barrier-free and offers children's facilities. The kitchen uses high-quality products from the region. As a starting point for hiking and winter sports, it is just a few minutes' walk from the ski area and the cross-country ski trail.
